name: Hazels Panzerwerke
description:
Hazel's tank factories are an international mark of quality! Attention: the plant does not process nuts, it got this name in honor of the chief game designer — Hazel-Rah!
Excellent handling and first-class dynamics of these tank cars laid the foundation for success. The perfect combination of power, speed and cross-country ability allows you to lead in the global arena. No matter how many competitors try to declassify unique technologies, they still fail to do so. Such a tough nut is too tough for rivals!
See also: Paints
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on february 24th, 2023.
Hazels Panzerwerke could have been obtained during The «Rally Tankcar» Event.
